definitions.explanation: The first and best-known cryptocurrency, a decentralized digital currency with no central issuer. Often abbreviated BTC.

notes:
The original cryptocurrency, launched in 2009. A representative ⟦{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}→仮想通貨：06400_kasoutsuuka⟧, often abbreviated BTC and treated as the benchmark of the crypto market.
